name: Anacostia
reason: For The Weekly News (sn82016441). Anacostia is part of Washington, so the gazetteer has no point for it; it stays its own place, at Anacostia rather than central Washington.
source: Not recorded: added in PR #190, which gives no source for the coordinates.

reason: For the Cherokee Phoenix (sn83020866) and the Cherokee Phoenix, and Indians' Advocate (sn83020874), both published at New Echota, Gordon County. Without it, geocode takes the median of the two records' points, which are 84 km apart: sn83020866's record names the town New Town and its latlong (34.018537, -84.263583) is outside Gordon County. The Census gazetteer has no New Echota.
source: LoC title record sn83020874, field latlong (https://www.loc.gov/item/sn83020874/); its location_city is echota, its location_county gordon.

reason: For Zajedničar = Fraternalist (sn84024547), labelled (Allegheny, Pa.). Without it, geocode takes the LoC record's one latlong, which belongs to Youngstown, Ohio (41.09832, -80.650648), about 85 km away: the record lists the cities allegheny, pittsburgh and youngstown, so its point is only a multi-city last resort. The Census gazetteer has no Allegheny, which merged into Pittsburgh in 1907; it stays its own place, as the town was separate when the paper began (1894).
source: Wikipedia, Allegheny, Pennsylvania, coordinates 40°26′30″N 80°00′00″W (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Allegheny,_Pennsylvania, revision 1374619177, read 2026-10-08). LoC record https://www.loc.gov/item/sn84024547/ for the Youngstown latlong it replaces.

reason: For The Vancouver Independent (pages sn87093109, record sn84022797, #120). Neither of its LoC records has coordinates, so without this it would sit at Washington's centroid.
source: The city's coordinates from public gazetteers, not from LoC (PR #166); which gazetteer isn't recorded. They aren't the Census gazetteer's point for Vancouver, WA (45.63716,-122.59657).
